verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated first-party 'Coding agents' guide for connecting Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Pi to Model APIs through Baseten Switch. Its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints let standard SDKs plug in. Agent-framework coverage is thinner: the only framework example is a LangChain ChatOpenAI snippet inside the structured-outputs doc. Missing for 10: dedicated integration guides for agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, etc.), coverage of other coding agents beyond Switch-supported ones, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
